_comment: Lightning Phase 9 remediation (database side): the deep-dive findings against the disconnect/reconnect work (20261008050805), closed after the app-side half merged (#6499) and Phase 10 (20261008111425) applied. The migration creates no function and no table and alters nothing: every change is an asserted substitution into a body PokerIQ-Production already carries, so this fragment promises nothing new. FINDING 1: fn_lightning_reconnect_state now answers the caller's MOST RECENT exited session (state 'ended', exit_reason verbatim, the still-held anchor seat pointer, the ending stack) instead of NULL, so a returning client can tell timed out from stopped from gone; the open answer keeps its exact shape plus exit_reason null. FINDING 4: the snapshot's hand_id is scoped to an id public.lightning_hand actually carries (null while the instance forms), leaving the shared fn_lightning_player_live_hand and its coalesce untouched for its other callers. FINDING 3: fn_lightning_reap_expired_disconnects clamps p_limit above with LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(1, coalesce(p_limit, 200)), 2000). FINDING 6: the reaper and fn_lightning_stop_playing never mutate a pool-session row of a frozen Cluster (cluster_mode 'frozen'); the stop mark is still recorded and the exit waits for the thaw. FINDING 2 (DB half): fn_lightning_fast_fold and fn_lightning_stop_playing clear the caller's own stale disconnected stamp (one player_reconnected event, never on a frozen Cluster), the database's own self-heal beside the app's retry.
